description: Source code for validating limitations in shader code, including loop and index validation, within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ValidateConstIndexExpr
classes.description: Traverser to validate if an expression is a constant index expression, including loop indices.

classes.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser
classes.description: Traverser to validate shader limitations such as loop correctness and index constraints.

methods.name: GetLoopSymbolId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID of the loop index variable.

methods.name: ValidateConstIndexExpr::isValid
methods.description: Checks if the expression is a valid constant index expression.

methods.name: ValidateConstIndexExpr::visitSymbol
methods.description: Visits a symbol node to determine if it is a valid loop index or constant.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::visitSymbol
methods.description: Checks if a symbol is a loop index and if it is assigned within the loop body.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::visitBinary
methods.description: Checks binary operations, especially indexing operations, for validity.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::visitLoop
methods.description: Validates loop type and header, and traverses loop body.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::isLoopIndex
methods.description: Determines if a symbol is a loop index based on stored symbol IDs.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateForLoopHeader
methods.description: Validates the structure of a 'for' loop header.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateForLoopInit
methods.description: Validates the initialization part of a 'for' loop.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::isConstExpr
methods.description: Checks if a node is a constant expression.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::isConstIndexExpr
methods.description: Checks if a node is a valid constant index expression.
